column1: # Official Herdr releases the plugin supports (README: "Requires Herdr 0.9.1 or newer").
# One row per release asset: version, asset name, SHA-256 of the GitHub release asset
# (GitHub's own asset digest, cross-checked by download). scripts/herdr-release-smoke
# runs the e2e smoke against every version here; `--check-upstream` fails when a newer
# official release is missing, and `--update` rewrites this file from GitHub.
